scheme_name: Assistance for Cattleshed, Gaman, Water Tank and Bucket
other_conditions: Applicant must own land or have at least a 10‑year lease agreement
Assistance can be availed only once in a lifetime
Eligibility category noted in source: Schedule Caste
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹30,000 as a one‑time grant for building a cattleshed, Gaman, water tank and bucket for Schedule Caste farmers.
